message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic chills and modern scares you might enjoy for a Friday‑night movie marathon:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A masterclass in dread—Jack Nicholson’s descent into madness set against an isolated hotel. |
| 2 | **Get Out** (2017) | Sharp social satire wrapped in a tense thriller; it’s as smart as it is scary. |
| 3 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A family drama that turns into a relentless nightmare; the soundtrack alone will keep you up. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Silence is survival—watch how sound design becomes a character. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** (2019) | Daylight horror at its best; the bright setting makes the gore even more jarring. |
| 6 | **It Follows** (2014) | An unsettling premise about a curse that follows you wherever you go. |
| 7 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | Paranormal investigation meets genuine terror; great for a spooky group binge. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological horror that feels like a metaphor for grief—and it’s beautifully shot. |
| 9 | **Paranormal Activity** (2007) | Found‑footage style that still manages to give you goosebumps. |
|10 | **The Ring** (2002) | A cursed videotape that’s become a staple of modern folklore. |

Feel free to shuffle them or pick a theme—whether you want psychological dread, supernatural thrills, or just pure gore, this list has something for every horror fan. Enjoy your frightful Friday night!
